problem_restatement: Test whether requiring causal agreement between compression direction and breakout direction removes the adverse HYPE entries observed under the generic v51 route without changing its stop or native exit contract.

frozen_contract.entry_filter: compression onset and breakout side must be aligned

later_evidence.interpretation: Both configured sides have one later aligned winner, but one lifecycle per side cannot establish repeatable forward expectancy.

occupancy_validation: Removing an opposed opener causally freed a later aligned signal and the replay entered it; the result is not a static post-filter of a fixed trade list.
decision: Retire the generic v51 HYPE route from the successor and stage the separately named alignment-only v2 route with the unchanged v51 per-position exposure and exact native exit contract. Do not claim proven profitability and do not increase HYPE size from this evidence.
uncertainties_and_failure_modes: The mechanism was selected after diagnosing the generic route.
The short development slice becomes negative after removing its largest winner.
Later evidence contains only one resolved lifecycle per side.
A narrower gate lowers cadence and can miss profitable opposed entries in a changed regime.
Modeled costs can differ from realized live fees, slippage, funding, and latency.
validation_completed: Causal occupancy-aware replay under the exact native exit contract
Later long and prospective short outcome attribution
Versioned live collector TDD for aligned, opposed, and unavailable pressure
validation_still_required: Multiple attributable forward closes on each side
Realized fee, slippage, funding, and entry-age reconciliation

proposal.observed_problem_or_opportunity: Generic HYPE admitted 106 opposed versus 44 aligned development onsets and produced negative exact v51 closed economics.
proposal.why_now: v51 is draining and the exact causal repair has completed before the successor boundary.
proposal.evidence_reviewed: Exact v51 HYPE closes, causal development replay, later confirmation, prospective aligned short, route friction, and collector behavior.
proposal.identifiable_edge: Aligned compression and breakout direction showed materially stronger after-cost development economics than opposed direction.
proposal.applicable_market_regime: Only completed-bar compression onsets where the causal breakout side is available and agrees with the intended side.
proposal.alternatives_considered: Keep generic HYPE; retire HYPE entirely; static side gate; profit lock; alignment-only new identity.
proposal.proposed_live_change: Replace generic HYPE v1 with alignment-only HYPE v2 in a new successor profile; preserve stop, opposite-signal exit, and soft/hard hold contract.
proposal.expected_upside: Avoid the historically adverse opposed subset while retaining both-side aligned opportunities.
proposal.main_risks_and_failure_modes: Sparse later evidence, short-side winner dependence, regime drift, reduced cadence, and live execution friction.
proposal.backtest_or_simulation_evidence: 41 aligned-only causal trades, PF 1.8569, 3/5 positive folds, +289.255 bps excluding the largest winner.
proposal.live_or_forward_evidence: One later aligned long winner and one prospective aligned short winner; diagnostic only.
proposal.success_metrics: Exact both-side forward attribution, positive after-cost net, no contract mismatch, and improving largest-winner-independent evidence.
proposal.failure_or_rollback_triggers: Any provider identity/exit mismatch, opposed or unavailable entry, repeated after-cost losses, or realized friction materially exceeding evidence.
proposal.confidence_level: medium on the discriminator; low-to-medium on deployable expectancy

falsifier: Update or reject this disposition if the frozen alignment-only route becomes nonpositive after exact live costs, remains dependent on one winner as the sample grows, admits any opposed or unavailable entry, or a predeclared compatible forward window contradicts the development separation.
